claim: The sprite clip window (NextREG 0x19) is in display-area pixels only while sprites are not over the border; with 0x15 bit 1 set it is ignored unless bit 5 is set too, and then X counts in units of two dots across the wide area.
limit: From the book, not measured here. The reset window is X 0-255, Y 0-191.

evidence.source: I. Novak, Unraveling the ZX Spectrum Next, Vol 1 (2026; core 3.03.03), chapter 16
evidence.text: Over border off: dots 32 + X1 to 32 + X2 and lines 32 + Y1 to 32 + Y2. Over border on, clip bit off: the whole wide area shows. Both on: dots 2 x X1 to 2 x X2 + 1, lines Y1 to Y2. The clip is applied as the line buffer is read out.
